summary: Fresh complete-value review accepts the existing Japanese assembly Help against the current English source, including possible attached-image movement. All seven paragraphs and 32 complete sentence/clause units were assessed in actual UI/model context.
reviewed_english_value:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. The first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Following images fill its gap; they stay placed. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
reviewed_localized_value:
Android のファイル選択画面から最大20枚の画像を追加できます。下部のトレイには、サムネイル、ファイル名、トリミングと［同じ幅］または［同じ高さ］の調整を反映した画像寸法が表示されます。提供元からファイル更新日時を取得できる場合は、その日時も表示されます。ファイル名または更新日時で並べ替えられますが、並べ替えても配置済み画像の位置は変わりません。

サムネイルをタップして選択します。［画像をトリミング］はその画像をトリミングし、［一括トリミング］は選択した画像にピクセルまたは百分率の余白指定を適用します。トリミングハンドルをドラッグするか、数値を入力してください。［トリミングをリセット］で元の端に戻せます。トリミングは非破壊で、元に戻すこともできます。

サムネイルを長押しするか、作業領域に配置済みの画像をドラッグし、強調表示された辺へドロップします。半透明のプレビューにはスナップ後の正確な結果が表示されます。右側への接続では上端がそろい、下側への接続では左端がそろいます。サムネイルをタップしてから「+」のターゲットをタップすることもできます。最初の画像は原点に配置されます。親画像をトリミングすると、そこに接続した画像も移動する場合があります。重なりは許可されません。

［同じ幅］と［同じ高さ］では、各画像固有の縦横比を維持したまま、すべての入力画像の寸法をそろえます。ピクセル、百分率、最小、最大から選択してください。［元のサイズに戻す］では寸法の統一だけを解除し、トリミングは保持します。

［配置解除］は選択した画像だけをトレイへ戻します。後続の画像は隙間を詰めますが、配置済みのままです。［削除］はその入力画像だけを削除します。［元に戻す］／［やり直し］でこれらの変更を復元できます。配置済み画像をドラッグすると並べ替えられ、空白部分をドラッグすると表示を移動できます。ピンチでズームできます。［すべて表示］は結合画像全体が見える倍率に変更するだけで、出力寸法は変更しません。

［PNG を保存］は結合済み画像を直接保存します。［Paintで編集］はメインエディターへ転送し、元に戻せる画像置換として扱います。出力がメモリ上限を超える場合は、選択画面が表示されたときに小さい出力コピーを選択してください。ごく小さい出力でもメモリ上限を超える場合は、サイズの選択画面の代わりにメモリ警告が表示されます。元の画像ファイルは変更されません。現在の結合状態は端末内に保存され、戻ってきたときに再度開かれます。

このモードには、メインエディターの［ファイル］→［このアプリについて・ライセンス・クレジット］メニューに記載されているものと同じ Catrobat/AGPL および素材クレジットが適用されます。

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Add up to 20 images with Android\'s file picker.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: Android のファイル選択画面から最大20枚の画像を追加できます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: The Android file-picker route and maximum of 20 images are both explicit. 最大20枚 is a natural image count, not a minimum or per-operation allowance.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 下部のトレイには、サムネイル、ファイル名、トリミングと［同じ幅］または［同じ高さ］の調整を反映した画像寸法が表示されます。提供元からファイル更新日時を取得できる場合は、その日時も表示されます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: All tray fields survive: thumbnails, names, dimensions after crop and any common-width/height normalization, plus modification time only when the provider supplies it. Japanese separates the conditional timestamp into a second sentence without losing the condition.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ファイル名または更新日時で並べ替えられますが、並べ替えても配置済み画像の位置は変わりません。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Both filename and modification-time sort keys are retained; the negative statement is about positions of already placed images. It does not confuse tray order with canvas arrangement.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Tap a thumbnail to select it.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: サムネイルをタップして選択します。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Thumbnail tap selects the image, with a clear singular referent.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［画像をトリミング］はその画像をトリミングし、［一括トリミング］は選択した画像にピクセルまたは百分率の余白指定を適用します。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Both actions are covered: Crop image affects that image, while Batch crop applies numeric pixel or percentage edge margins to selected images. 余白指定 is comprehensible as the trim-margin specification in this explicitly cropping context; it does not instruct adding a border.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Drag crop handles or type amounts.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: トリミングハンドルをドラッグするか、数値を入力してください。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Touch-handle dragging and numeric amount entry remain alternatives.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Reset crop restores the original edges.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［トリミングをリセット］で元の端に戻せます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Reset returns the crop to the original image edges. 元の端 is understandable in this crop context; no destructive reset or image replacement is implied.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: トリミングは非破壊で、元に戻すこともできます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Both non-destructive operation and undoability are retained. Neither original-file mutation nor an irreversible crop is implied.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: サムネイルを長押しするか、作業領域に配置済みの画像をドラッグし、強調表示された辺へドロップします。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Both placement gestures survive: long-press a thumbnail, or drag an already placed image; then drop onto the highlighted edge. 長押し usefully makes the source gesture explicit.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 半透明のプレビューにはスナップ後の正確な結果が表示されます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Translucent preview and exact post-snap result are retained. スナップ後 correctly describes the snapped placement rather than an independent image resize.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 右側への接続では上端がそろい、下側への接続では左端がそろいます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Both directional alignment clauses are correct: right attachment aligns top edges; bottom attachment aligns left edges. No direction is inverted.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: サムネイルをタップしてから「+」のターゲットをタップすることもできます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: The alternative sequence remains thumbnail tap followed by the + target, not two independent commands.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: The first image starts at the origin.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 最初の画像は原点に配置されます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: The first image is placed at the origin; 原点 is accurate coordinate language.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Attached images may move when their parent is cropped.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 親画像をトリミングすると、そこに接続した画像も移動する場合があります。
clause_dispositions.rationale: The complete current warning is accepted. 親画像 identifies the cropped parent; そこに接続した画像 identifies the attached image; 移動する場合があります expresses possibility, not inevitable movement. The added も is ordinary Japanese linkage and does not assert the parent itself moves. No claim is made that the attachment relationship is changed.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Overlaps are rejected.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 重なりは許可されません。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Overlaps are prohibited/rejected. 重なり is the correct visual overlap noun; the sentence is not a clipping or stacking instruction.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image\'s own aspect ratio.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［同じ幅］と［同じ高さ］では、各画像固有の縦横比を維持したまま、すべての入力画像の寸法をそろえます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: The selected common width or height applies to every input while each image keeps its own aspect ratio. 寸法 is broader than the English singular dimension in isolation, but the two named axis commands plus 各画像固有の縦横比 make the intended one-axis normalization unambiguous here.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ピクセル、百分率、最小、最大から選択してください。
clause_dispositions.rationale: All four choices survive: pixels, percent, Smallest, Largest. 百分率 is an accurate synonym of the UI label パーセント; it is not an incorrect unit. The source itself abbreviates the percent reference and this translation does not invent a different reference.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［元のサイズに戻す］では寸法の統一だけを解除し、トリミングは保持します。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Restore original sizes removes normalization only and preserves crops. 寸法の統一だけを解除し explicitly prevents confusing it with Reset crop.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［配置解除］は選択した画像だけをトレイへ戻します。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Unplace affects only the selected image and returns it to the tray. Selection scope and retention of the input are explicit.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Following images fill its gap; they stay placed.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 後続の画像は隙間を詰めますが、配置済みのままです。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Successor images close the gap but remain placed. 隙間を詰めます conveys reflow and 配置済みのまま preserves the important non-removal guarantee.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Remove deletes only that input.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［削除］はその入力画像だけを削除します。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Remove deletes only that input image; it is clearly distinguished from Unplace. In context 入力画像 refers to the assembly input, not deletion of the external original file.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Undo/Redo restore these changes.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［元に戻す］／［やり直し］でこれらの変更を復元できます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Undo and Redo restore/reapply these operations. The noun やり直し is a natural reference to Redo; the actual resource is やり直す. This minor grammatical label variation does not change the action or warrant blocking the complete value.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 配置済み画像をドラッグすると並べ替えられ、空白部分をドラッグすると表示を移動できます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Dragging a placed image rearranges it; dragging empty space pans the view. 表示を移動 disambiguates panning from moving the output image.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Pinch to zoom.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ピンチでズームできます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Pinching changes zoom. The phrase is standard and keeps the gesture.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［すべて表示］は結合画像全体が見える倍率に変更するだけで、出力寸法は変更しません。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Show all changes viewing magnification to reveal the whole assembly and never changes output dimensions. Both the positive behavior and negative guarantee are explicit.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Save PNG saves the assembled image directly.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［PNG を保存］は結合済み画像を直接保存します。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Save PNG directly saves the assembled output; PNG and the action name are retained. Directly here contrasts with transferring to the editor, not a promise that no document destination picker appears. This matches the English context.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ［Paintで編集］はメインエディターへ転送し、元に戻せる画像置換として扱います。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Edit in Paint transfers the assembly to the main editor as an undoable image replacement. Both the destination and undoability survive.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 出力がメモリ上限を超える場合は、選択画面が表示されたときに小さい出力コピーを選択してください。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Exceeding the memory budget is the condition; the instruction is to choose a smaller output copy only when the choice UI is offered. The Japanese conditional does not promise that a size chooser is always available.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: ごく小さい出力でもメモリ上限を超える場合は、サイズの選択画面の代わりにメモリ警告が表示されます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: The tiny-output exception is complete: if even tiny output exceeds the memory budget, show a memory warning instead of a size chooser. No futile resize option is promised.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: Original source files stay unchanged.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 元の画像ファイルは変更されません。
clause_dispositions.rationale: Original source image files remain unchanged. The Japanese statement is direct and does not expand the guarantee to external metadata or unrelated files.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: 現在の結合状態は端末内に保存され、戻ってきたときに再度開かれます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: The assembly is saved locally on the device and reopened on return. 端末内 is an appropriate localization of locally. This does not claim cross-device sync or persistence of the in-memory undo stack.

clause_dispositions.english_full_clause: This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor\'s «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
clause_dispositions.japanese_full_clause: このモードには、メインエディターの［ファイル］→［このアプリについて・ライセンス・クレジット］メニューに記載されているものと同じ Catrobat/AGPL および素材クレジットが適用されます。
clause_dispositions.rationale: The same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits apply and the main-editor navigation remains File > About, licences & credits. The Japanese menu name matches ui_about_credits23, and 素材クレジット accurately names asset credits. This is translation review of the existing notice, not a separate legal-compliance certification.

nonblocking_language_notes: The Help uses やり直し while ui_redo is やり直す. This noun/verb variation is understandable and semantically faithful; an exact-label house-style cleanup could align them, but it is not necessary for current-value acceptance.
百分率 is the correct native-language synonym for パーセント; 寸法 and 余白指定 are assessed in their complete normalization/cropping sentences, not in isolation.
runtime_and_scope_limits: This is a fresh independent model/source-assisted linguistic and source-context review of one complete resource element, not a native-human review.

No Android build, instrumentation run, Robolectric execution, installed-app interaction, screenshot inspection, font coverage, clipping, line wrapping, scrolling or accessibility verification was performed in this review.
Existing model tests were read as corroborating specification and were not executed or promoted into new runtime evidence.
The review accepts the complete Japanese value at the stated English/Japanese hashes only. It does not confer whole-catalogue, whole-locale, release, or broader localization acceptance.
The review provides new full-value evidence; prior review identities, unchanged localized hashes and isolated term matches were not used as acceptance substitutes.
No application file, tracker file or external repository state was changed or published. No replacement candidate is necessary because the current complete value is accepted.
